releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.55 — two screens WhatsApp users look for. Settings now has Storage and data: every row is measured from a directory this app owns (photos and avatars, voice notes and videos, camera captures, message history, recorded notes, downloaded updates, drafts/stars/cached lists), with a Clear button each and one Clear all. Rows whose loss you would notice — message history, drafts — ask first and say exactly what goes. In a chat, ⋮ → Media, links and docs opens every photo and video shared there as a grid, every document, and every link, each with who sent it and when; tapping a photo opens the full-screen viewer you already know, with swiping and zoom.
